layout.titlePlacement: Left column, wrapped to a maximum of three lines.
layout.subtitlePlacement: Under the title with asset count or route context.
layout.brandPlacement: Small brand line in the lower-left corner.
layout.previewImageLayout: Three to five clean framed WebP previews on the right side.
layout.fallbackBehavior: Use homepage/gallery previews when a route has too few local items.

typography.display: Fraunces-inspired serif fallback in the generated SVG overlay.
typography.body: Figtree-inspired sans-serif fallback in the generated SVG overlay.
typography.titleWrapping: Approximate character wrapping with a three-line cap.

rules: Do not use source SVG URLs as social images.
Do not use gradients, heavy shadows, random colors, or nested-card styling.
Keep route title and printable coloring page context readable at thumbnail sizes.
